description: The bar chart illustrates the average entropy across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments, comparing the performance of different AI models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "GPT-4", "Claude", and "Llama", which are the different AI models being compared, and is categorical in nature. The vertical axis is labeled "Entropy average Values" and has a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a different AI model, and within each group, there are three bars colored blue, red, and green, representing "Baseline", "Source Info", and "Direct Command" methods, respectively. The bars for GPT-4 have approximate values of 4.6 for Baseline, 5.0 for Source Info, and 4.7 for Direct Command; for Claude, the values are approximately 4.4 for Baseline, 5.2 for Source Info, and 4.8 for Direct Command; and for Llama, the values are around 4.3 for Baseline, 4.8 for Source Info, and 4.6 for Direct Command. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
